status_legend.generated_candidate: File exists; not normalized or accepted.
status_legend.normalized_candidate: Dimensions/pivots/files verified; art still subject to review.
status_legend.engine_verified: Imported and checked in the target engine/runtime.
status_legend.accepted: Art and gameplay-scale review passed; approval source recorded.

status_legend.study_only: Exploratory output exists; not yet a coherent production candidate for its intended slot.
status_legend.approved_reference: An already approved visual identity reference; does not imply engine readiness or approval of derived candidates.
